summary: Your colors, font and logo, for anyone making a flyer or a printed menu.
content:
Hand this page to anyone designing something for the restaurant, such as a printer or a local magazine.

## Colors

| Color | Hex |
|---|---|
| Thistle green | `#00452D` |
| Deep green | `#001D10` |
| Copper | `#EC9B6D` |

## Font

The website uses **Archivo**, a free font from Google Fonts. Headlines are heavy and all capitals.

## Logo

Use the copper thistle on a dark green background. Please don't stretch it, recolor it or put it over a busy photo. Ask me for the original files, because a copy saved from the website won't print well.

## How you sound

Warm, plain and short. You write the way a good server talks: you know the food, and you don't show off about it.
title: Your brand at a glance
author: Sam Keller
